punchline: Maxwell had led his church well for eight years, and three decisions made outside his usual process still cost him his congregation's trust.
thirty_sec: After eight good years as senior pastor at Skyline Church, John Maxwell fired someone, cancelled a service and changed the Christmas show, all without his usual process. His congregation's trust dropped. He apologized in public, asked forgiveness and won it back. Maxwell calls trust the foundation of leadership and compares it to pocket change: decisions add coins, mistakes take them out.
